mission: ControlAI is a campaigning nonprofit working to prevent the extinction risk it attributes to 'runaway machine intelligence' (superintelligence). It briefs lawmakers in the UK, US, Canada and Germany, helps citizens contact their representatives, and calls for an international prohibition on developing superintelligence while allowing narrower AI.

key_work.title: A Narrow Path
key_work.plain_summary: ControlAI's policy plan: stop the development of superintelligence for about 20 years, set up international institutions to enforce this, and only later consider how to proceed safely.

key_work.title: The Compendium
key_work.plain_summary: A plain-language guide (by Connor Leahy, Gabriel Alfour, Andrea Miotti and others) explaining why the race to AGI could lead to human extinction and what can be done.

key_work.title: Campaign to ban runaway machine intelligence / superintelligence
key_work.plain_summary: ControlAI says it has briefed 400+ lawmakers and that 200+ back its campaign, and that it consulted on the first US bill to ban runaway machine intelligence.

warnings.text: AI companies aim to build fully autonomous systems; the result could be 'runaway machine intelligence' able to overpower any country's security forces.
This could arrive before 2030, and no method exists to contain such a system.
Superintelligence would threaten the lives of everyone on Earth (extinction risk).

recommendations.text: Ban the development of runaway machine intelligence / superintelligence, nationally and internationally.
Keep developing narrow, controllable AI applications.
Have the public contact lawmakers and get politicians to publicly recognise extinction risk from AI.
